; PROBE (temporary): are the sleep-related settings writable from QML?
; Tries assign -> read-back -> RESTORE on: Settings.idleToSuspendDelay (light->deep
; transition candidate), Settings.lightSleepEnabled (the Visible content toggle),
; BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay. Never triggers sleep. Removed after journal read.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: settingsWriteProbe
				visible: false

				function tryWrite(name, obj, prop, testValue) {
					try {
						var orig = obj[prop];
						obj[prop] = testValue;
						var after = obj[prop];
						obj[prop] = orig;
						var restored = obj[prop];
						console.log("WRITEPROBE " + name + ": orig=" + orig
							+ " wrote=" + testValue + " readback=" + after
							+ " restored=" + restored
							+ (after === testValue ? " => WRITABLE" : " => read-only"));
					} catch (e) {
						console.log("WRITEPROBE " + name + ": threw " + e);
					}
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 5000
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						settingsWriteProbe.tryWrite("Settings.idleToSuspendDelay",
							Settings, "idleToSuspendDelay", 9599000);
						settingsWriteProbe.tryWrite("Settings.idleSuspendDelay",
							Settings, "idleSuspendDelay", 299000);
						settingsWriteProbe.tryWrite("Settings.lightSleepEnabled",
							Settings, "lightSleepEnabled", true);
						settingsWriteProbe.tryWrite("BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay",
							BatteryManager, "deepSleepDelay", 9599000);
						settingsWriteProbe.tryWrite("BatteryManager.infiniteSleep",
							BatteryManager, "infiniteSleep", true);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
